headline: Frontline Bloodshed Intensifies Bases Shift Across Six Sectors
war_summary: Since the 06:06 edition the war's hottest sectors have kept bleeding while the front line remains largely frozen elsewhere. Weathered Expanse still leads the butcher's bill with roughly 5,900 Colonial and 6,600 Warden losses in the last day, and hourly loss rates are now accelerating on both sides. Nevish Line continues to hemorrhage — over 6,200 Colonial and 5,900 Warden casualties — though the most recent hour shows a slight cooling for Colonial losses while Warden rates hold steady. Marban Hollow and Kuura Strand each recorded another thirty‑plus base‑ownership changes in the past 24 hours; Kuura Strand's enlistment surge has eased, while Marban Hollow sees both factions trading ground at an increasing clip. Linn Mercy has accelerated sharply, posting 26 Colonial and 78 Warden casualties per hour in the latest window, with enlistments rising. Godcrofts saw a base turn neutral early this morning, the only fresh turnover there. Farranac Coast logged two captures yesterday, while Pari Peak, Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle each recorded a handful of ownership flips. Dead Lands and Callahans Passage remain casualty‑heavy but report no base changes. Enlistment spikes persist in the most contested zones, suggesting the current flare‑ups may sustain through the next day.
